correctness.rationale: From v2=(A^−1−mI)v1/nu, exactly Av2=(v1−m Av1)/nu. Orthogonal projection residuals onto span{v1,v2} are proportional, so squared local mixed/split indicator ratio =m² s/(1−2mt+m²s), where m=E λ^−1, t=E λ, s=E λ² of the unit spectral measure. Define T=(2mt−1)/(m²s). Variation under a point mass uses φ(λ)=T_m/λ+T_t λ+T_s λ²; T_m≤0,T_s<0 make φ strictly concave, forcing a global minimizing measure for T to the spectral endpoints of [1,κ]. For endpoint weight p, γ^−2=Qκ(p), with unique maximum at positive cubic root by Descartes. Two-point maximizer breaks the third step; three-active-eigenvalue measures approach the infimum strictly. Checked exact symbolic derivative ∂p Q=Pκ(p)*κ(κ−1)²/[(1+(κ−1)p)^3(κ²−(κ²−1)p)^2], transformed positive cubic, and numerical Γ2=2.8835477563561254, Γ10=1.1597773406453498; all agree. Domain n≥3 SPD with at least three active distinct eigenvalues, cond≤κ and k=3 only. Neither actual floating point error nor later steps are bounded.
